claim_new: global advisory lock, capacity, per-bot exclusivity, SKIP LOCKED lock order, preflight checks, session mapping, prompt assembly, attempt insertion
claim_existing: lease takeover of active attempts after 12s lease expiry (crash recovery)
drive: start run with Idempotency-Key, poll status, stream events, budget accounting, deliver decisions/steering, queue monitor assessments
settle: map runtime terminal status into task state machine, bounded automatic recovery, outcome settlement, result message
advance_waiters: request expiry closure, coordination wakeups, waiting_input/computer resume, dependency release, child result resumption, deadline/grant expiry stops

notes.text: WORKER_ID is a fresh UUID per process; leases are 12 seconds; claim_existing takes over expired leases with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED.
claim_new serializes admission with pg_advisory_xact_lock(887832103) and bounds concurrency by workspace max_active minus active/reserved attempts.
A DB unique partial index allows one active attempt per bot (including uncertain).
Native dispatch idempotency: Idempotency-Key 'hermbot:{attempt_id}' re-sent on retry; after 23h the attempt is marked uncertain instead of replaying.
Automatic recovery only for definite retryable failures before any tool started with complete event coverage, bounded by MAX_RECOVERIES.

table:tasks.purpose: Executions/assignments (owner-facing roots, delegated children, peer-message responses, intake carriers). Holds input, status, continuation, pending_result/outcomes, budget/stop fields, intake_* fields, versions (orchestration/coordination/work_revision), request_key idempotency.

table:messages.purpose: Conversation transcript rows (owner 'user' messages and bot 'assistant' results); source_id UNIQUE gives idempotent inserts (request:{task}, runtime-result:{attempt}, steer:...).

table:events.purpose: Append-only application event log (SSE source, activity, monitor evidence, tool.started coverage for recovery). source_id UNIQUE deduplicates runtime events and receipts.

table:approvals.purpose: Owner reviews of exact proposed actions (runtime command approvals, connector/skill/memory/lifecycle/generic/secure input) with payload_hash, expiry, supersede chain.

table:dependencies.purpose: Legacy sibling assignment dependencies (child waits for depends_on to complete; status blocked).

table:controls.purpose: Directions to a task's execution: owner/manager steer, owner revision commands (same id as work_commands), monitor guidance; delivered via native steer or folded into next continuation.

table:work_items.purpose: User-facing work cards: objective, revision, outcomes_version, orchestration_version, active budget, hidden_at, legacy flag. Status is derived (no status column).

table:work_changes.purpose: Immutable revision log per work item (created/update/cancelled/owner actions) with source owner message; UNIQUE(work_item_id,revision); used for idempotent apply and owner_instructions context.

table:work_commands.purpose: Durable outbox of 'revise' commands per (task, revision, kind) for active executions; materialized into controls with the same id.

table:work_item_messages.purpose: Association of owner messages to work items with intent (display/routing provenance).

table:work_outcomes.purpose: Required results per work item: key, kind, required, revision, target, dependencies, status, evidence_strength, owner_task_id (accountable assignment).

table:task_outcomes.purpose: Binding of a task to outcomes at a specific outcome_revision (stale bindings cannot fulfil newer revisions).

table:outcome_evidence.purpose: Evidence references per outcome revision (artifact, connector_operation, execution, owner_reconciliation) with strength; UNIQUE(outcome_id,revision,kind,reference).

table:result_contributions.purpose: Contribution responsibilities of child tasks to an outcome revision (required flag, expected_output, status, submission, reviewed_by).

table:result_acceptances.purpose: One immutable acceptance per outcome revision with evidence snapshot (artifact sha/version, review, requirement, objective).

table:coordination_waits.purpose: Explicit hermbot_wait records: task waits on a child task (dependency_id) or a sent teammate message (message_id).

table:teammate_messages.purpose: Durable peer inbox messages (scoped to conversation/work), with delivery to attempt and response task.

table:input_requests.purpose: Typed owner questions (text/choice/confirmation) with question_hash, expiry, answer and provenance.

table:attention_items.purpose: Owner attention entries keyed by (subject_type, subject_id, purpose) with material version/fingerprint, read/dismiss versions, active/needs_owner.

table:attention_pending.purpose: Transactional dirty-subject obligations with generation counter, due_at and failure backoff; written by DB triggers and attention.drain.

table:execution_assessments.purpose: Queued/evaluated decision-provider assessments per attempt and evidence hash; one pending per attempt.

table:attempts.purpose: Native execution attempts: session, runtime_run_id, Idempotency-Key, status, lease (worker_id/lease_until), response JSON (request, terminal, coverage flags), active-seconds accounting.

table:tool_receipts.purpose: Idempotent responses of hermbot tool calls keyed bot:task:tool_call_id with request_hash.

table:owner_receipts.purpose: Idempotent owner mutation receipts (registry.mutation) keyed by Idempotency-Key with request hash.

table:sessions.purpose: Native Hermes session id per (conversation, bot); created at first claim.

table:thread_sessions.purpose: Native Hermes session per (thread root message, bot) so reply threads have separate native sessions.

table:conversations.purpose: DMs (one per bot) and groups; archived_at hides from roster and blocks new work.

table:participants.purpose: Conversation membership; gates task assignment, mentions and peer messaging.

table:attachments.purpose: Owner-uploaded conversation attachments stored in MinIO (object_key, sha256).

table:work_authorizations.purpose: Owner-quoted authorizations for requested external actions bound to an outcome revision; revoked on supersede/drop/revision.

features.purpose: The owner just sends chat messages. Hermbot decides, before any bot executes, whether a message is discussion, a status question, a new assignment, an update to existing work, an answer to a pending question, a cancellation or a routine draft. It records concrete required results and owner-quoted authorizations, keeps one work card per requested outcome across many messages and bots, and delivers revisions to running or waiting executions. Cards can be hidden/restored without touching execution.

logic.step: POST /api/v1/messages (intent auto by default) creates the carrier task (status queued, orchestration_version=2, coordination_version=1, intake_status pending) and the owner message in one transaction, idempotent on Idempotency-Key.
claim_new never dispatches a v2 task while message_intent is still 'auto', so nothing executes before interpretation.

work_intake.advance_one (worker background loop) claims the oldest pending auto task per conversation (FIFO: no earlier pending task in the same conversation) with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and a 60s lease.

Evidence is assembled: latest owner message, 60 recent messages, pending questions, up to 30 candidate work items with outcomes, saved routines, standing grants, supported connector actions, current time, JSON schema.

The receiving bot's provider/model is called at {base_url}/chat/completions with json_object response, optional read_context tool (<=3 calls per round), up to 4 rounds within 45s; schema/alignment validation errors are fed back as system messages.
apply() re-locks the task, refuses if the owner edited the message (hash) or any observed work revision changed, then forces owner_work_target when the message came from Redirect/edit/answer.
Each operation beyond the first gets a derived task (request_key intake:{task}:{index}) inheriting grant, files and thread, so one message can both answer and revise work.
Routine intent saves an inactive draft after quote/conversation/bot checks; the carrier becomes discussion with a continuation telling the bot to point at the draft.
Cancel intent cancels non-terminal roots of the work item and supersedes all its requirements.

Other intents go through work_items.route(intake=True): assignment -> new_item; update -> fences (unless intake), reuse responsible participant when previous root settled, or mark 'steered' when an active root exists; status/discussion just tag the message.
Assignment/update then call work_controller.apply with requirements (nulls preserve existing target/dependencies/required), supersede_keys and requested_effects.

work_controller.apply is idempotent per (work item, source owner message, kind), supersedes requirements (invalidating undispatched drafts and authorizations), registers requirements with owner_revision=True, bumps work revision, records authorizations whose quote is a substring of the owner message, writes work_changes, and emits 'revise' commands for every other non-terminal task of the work item.

Commands are written to work_commands and to controls (same id) in the same transaction; work_controller.advance/reconcile later refreshes bindings, admits matching connector drafts and wakes waiting tasks that have pending owner directions.
Intake marks every carrier intake_status applied with intake_result and emits message.interpreted; clarification becomes a continuation instructing the bot to ask.
On failure: intake_status back to pending with 5s backoff; after 3 attempts 'failed' with a preserved-message error; the UI offers Retry interpretation.
Work cards are a projection: list_items picks the current root assignment, outputs (latest artifact per family), changes, directions, and status via outcomes.projection.
Owner hide/restore only toggles hidden_at; owner association correction (POST /api/v1/work-items/messages) only re-links settled messages.
Legacy path (orchestration v0, explicit intents or /api/v1/tasks): bot calls hermbot_route_message first; tool_action rejects any other tool while message_intent is auto.

decisions.decision: Interpret owner messages in the backend with a structured model call before execution, instead of letting the receiving bot route via hermbot_route_message.
decisions.why: Routing and execution were too coupled; mixed messages, cross-bot updates and independent objectives needed explicit handling above the harness.
decisions.alternatives: Bot-side routing tool (legacy v0, still supported); keyword classification (rejected in plan).
decisions.tradeoffs: Extra model call and latency per message; interpretation quality bounded by model; finite live cases do not prove universal understanding.

decisions.decision: Only the latest authenticated owner message is a source of authority; requested_effects and routine proposals must quote it verbatim.
decisions.why: Prevent background transcripts, bot statements or tool output from granting permissions (prompt injection).
decisions.tradeoffs: A paraphrase by the model fails validation and needs a retry round.

decisions.decision: Optimistic concurrency: apply only if message hash and observed work revisions are unchanged since evidence was gathered; no DB transaction held across the model call.
decisions.why: Avoid applying interpretations against edited messages or newer work; never hold locks across long calls.
decisions.alternatives: Hold row locks during the model call.
decisions.tradeoffs: Retry cost on contention (counts against 3 attempts).

decisions.decision: Per-conversation FIFO intake.
decisions.why: Later messages may revise what earlier ones created; interpretation must see prior effects.
decisions.tradeoffs: A failed/slow interpretation delays later messages in that conversation until it leaves pending/interpreting.

decisions.decision: Revisions are delivered as durable commands + controls written in the same transaction as the revision.
decisions.why: Settlement must see the direction; a later reconciliation pass cannot be the first place it appears (CTRL-01).
decisions.tradeoffs: Duplicate representation (work_commands + controls) keyed by same id.

decisions.decision: Work items are independent of execution trees; message association changes never stop/replay execution.
decisions.why: Owner needs a stable card per request across bots/turns while permissions stay per execution tree.
decisions.alternatives: One work item per task root (pre-008 model).
decisions.tradeoffs: Status must be projected from multiple tasks and outcomes.

invariants.enforcement: route update checks connector ops dispatching/uncertain/unresolved and uncertain attempts

failures.text: Provider error/invalid JSON: retry after 5s up to 3 attempts, then intake_status failed with error; owner Retry interpretation resets attempts.
Worker crash mid-interpretation: intake_lease_until (60s) expires and the task is reclaimed (intake_status 'interpreting' is claimable).
Owner edits message or work changes during interpretation: apply raises 409 -> counted as failed attempt and retried with fresh evidence.
Lock contention on update: route uses NOWAIT and returns 409 asking to retry shortly.
work_intake.run swallows all exceptions (DB outage) and continues.

Background context explicitly framed as evidence not instruction; read_context only reads same-conversation public messages up to the source message.
Shared work routing never transfers management grants: follow-ups cannot acquire an active manager's authority; cross-bot revisions use commands not grants.

Persist the revision's controls in the same transaction or settlement may miss them (CTRL-01).
Merge multiple update operations for one work item from a single message (CTRL-02).
Nulls in revisions must preserve existing targets/dependencies/required (CTRL-03).

features.title: Required results, evidence and result acceptance
features.purpose: Execution completion is not work completion. Each work item records versioned required results (report, artifact, connector_effect, execution_check, native_effect). Bots submit claims with hermbot_finish; the backend applies them only after the run settles and only with suitable evidence (provider receipts, accessible artifacts, reviewed contributions, tool execution evidence). The card shows partial progress, needs-answer/needs-approval/uncertain states, and the owner can drop requirements or reconcile uncertain native effects.

logic.step: Requirements are registered by intake (owner_revision) or, for legacy v0/v1 work, by the root task's hermbot_prepare.outcomes; keys unique, dependency graph acyclic, provenance = owner message.

Changing a requirement bumps its revision and resets it to pending; needs expected_revision; non-owner changes need a new owner update; fulfilled external effects immutable; owner revisions invalidate undispatched drafts and authorizations (retaining them if destination unchanged).
Root tasks are bound to all outcomes (task_outcomes with revision); children get only outcomes shared at delegation.
Coordination v1: each outcome gets an accountable owner_task_id (first live root assignment) and delegations create contributions or transfer the deliverable.
hermbot_publish/publish_file stores an artifact; if bound to an artifact/report outcome with ready dependencies it records evidence (or acceptance); otherwise supporting evidence only.

Connector actions bind to an unfinished connector_effect outcome and its revision; settlement of the operation calls effect_settled (succeeded -> record; denied/failed -> blocked; uncertain/unresolved -> uncertain).
hermbot_finish converts results-by-key into claims, validates them provisionally, and stores pending_result/pending_outcomes; nothing is fulfilled yet.

When the runtime settles, worker.settle calls outcomes.settle: non-completed runs fail unfinished assigned outcomes (except v2 helpers); completed runs re-validate claims in a savepoint and record each; any validation error rejects the whole batch (work.evidence_rejected).

record(): with an accountable owner it goes through result_acceptance.record: contributors' fulfilments become 'submitted' contributions; the owner's fulfilment validates contributions/reviews/read_artifact receipts and inserts a result_acceptances row (UNIQUE per outcome revision) then marks the outcome fulfilled.

Work status projection: uncertain > budget pause > (legacy fallback) > needs_answer > uncertain ops > needs_approval > working > completed (all required fulfilled) > cancelled > task stop states > needs_attention > working/planning.

Owner drop: versioned cancel of an unfulfilled requirement (v2 also invalidates drafts, revokes auth, cancels questions, records owner action); owner reconcile: uncertain native_effect -> fulfilled/failed/uncertain with owner evidence.
Budget interruption after a native tool started marks unconfirmed native_effect outcomes uncertain.

features.title: Teammate coordination: messages, delegation, waits, replacement
features.purpose: Teammates collaborate through backend-mediated tools. hermbot_message queues a scoped, non-blocking inbox message; hermbot_delegate creates an asynchronous child assignment (contribution or deliverable transfer); hermbot_wait names results actually required and releases execution capacity; failures wake the responsible teammate; settled unsuccessful contributions can be replaced. Legacy (coordination v0) delegation blocks the parent in waiting_children and resumes it with child results.

logic.step: hermbot_delegate -> tool_action -> service.delegate: bot running, no self-delegation, grant allows delegate, depth < MAX_DELEGATION_DEPTH, no ancestor cycle, root handoffs < min(MAX_HANDOFFS, grant), outcome ids required (v2 defaults to all unfinished assigned), sibling dependencies, granted artifacts/attachments, skill capability check.

Child task inserted queued (or blocked with dependencies) with handoff brief, same work item/intent/versions, grant inherited; task_outcomes shared; coordination v1 -> result_acceptance.assign creates contribution or transfers deliverable; dependencies rows; artifact_access; root handoffs+1.
Legacy: parent set waiting_children; v1: parent continues running.
hermbot_message (v1) -> coordination.send: recipient running, conversation participant or work collaborator or grant target; reply_to must address this bot; teammate_messages pending.
Busy recipient: /internal/context returns teammate_inbox; plugin llm_request injects it and calls /internal/inbox-delivered to mark delivered to the current attempt.

Idle recipient: claim_new first runs schedule_inboxes, which creates one internal peer_message discussion task per recipient/conversation/work for unanswered messages (or delivered ones whose attempt settled) and links response_task_id.
hermbot_wait -> coordination.wait: only directly owned child tasks (no same-bot, no wait cycle) or messages sent by this task; coordination_waits rows; task -> waiting_results.
At settlement a v1 task with unaccepted required contributions or an explicit wait stays waiting_results (capacity released).

advance_waiters -> coordination.advance: for each waiting_results task without active attempt, evaluate waits (child status/dependency_ready, replies, failed responses) and required contributions; requeue with a data-only continuation when nothing pending or something failed and the signature changed; clear waits when not pending.
Contributor finish submits contribution (result_acceptance.record), accountable owner then accepts with reviewed_task_ids and read_artifact receipts.

Replacement: delegate with replaces_task_id supersedes a settled failed/interrupted/cancelled contribution preserving required flag; manager reassign (grant op) replaces a failed child, rewires waits/dependencies/contributions.

Legacy dependencies: blocked children released in advance_waiters when all parents dependency_ready, with dependency outputs and artifact grants in continuation; waiting_children parents resume when children terminal (or actionable failure) and signature differs from observed_terminal_children.
Read access: hermbot_read_artifact only for artifacts produced by or granted to the task; status/work_status expose public assignment state.

features.title: Execution dispatch, policy, budgets, monitoring, stop/redirect/retry and recovery
features.purpose: Runs teammate work on per-bot Hermes runtimes continuously until completion, a real wait, Stop, an owner deadline or the shared active budget. The worker admits queued tasks one per bot under global capacity, dispatches native runs with stable idempotency keys, streams events, accounts active time, delivers decisions and directions, settles results, recovers safely after restarts, and refuses to replay anything whose effect may have happened (uncertain).

logic.step: claim_new: global advisory lock; capacity max_active - active/reserved attempts; per bot: active+running+provider+applied revision, no human computer control, readiness compatible, no pending lifecycle op, no active attempt; oldest queued eligible task.
Lock order with SKIP LOCKED: trigger locks, routine definition, work item, root task, bot row; then locked_task and recheck queued.
Preflight: routine/trigger start_allowed, pending connector ops -> waiting_approval, grant valid (else cancel), deadline (cancel kind deadline), budget (pause).

Native session per conversation/bot or per thread; prompt = continuation or input + thread context + skills + handoff brief + occurrence scope + attachments + granted files + pending owner/manager controls; instructions MANAGED_POLICY(v2)/POLICY + COORDINATION_POLICY.
Insert attempt 'dispatching' with Idempotency-Key hermbot:{attempt_id}, 12s lease; controls/work_commands included; task running, attempts+1, continuation/pending cleared; event task.started.

drive: copy attachments, ensure native session, POST /v1/runs (Idempotency-Key), store runtime_run_id; account time; pause if budget exhausted; stop if stopping; start event stream; GET /v1/runs/{id} status.
Terminal status -> settle; budget exhausted -> pause; else deliver decided runtime approvals (POST /approval) and one pending control (POST /steer), then queue a monitor assessment.
settle maps runtime terminal to task state (see sm:task), with bounded automatic recovery for retryable failures before any tool ran and complete event coverage (MAX_RECOVERIES).

Budgets: shared per work item (assignment/update) or per root; account() charges only while observed running; pause() moves tree to pausing_budget/paused_budget; Continue adds the workspace allowance after fences.

Monitor: when decision_mode enabled and a run is silent 180s or repeats tool failures, queue an assessment; separate loop claims it, re-validates currency, calls decisions.assess; with decision_actions and confidence>=0.85 inserts a monitor control (never stops/approves).

Stop: service.cancel stops descendants (attempts -> stopping; tasks cancelling or cancelled, uncertain kept), cancels pending reviews/questions/proposals/ops; drive sends POST /v1/runs/{id}/stop; settle preserves the owner's stop reason.
Redirect: service.steer; v2 creates an auto-intake message targeted at the work (revision path), legacy inserts a control delivered via native steer or next continuation.
Retry (owner): only settled failed/interrupted/cancelled, not all required fulfilled, no unknown connector outcome, whole tree settled; creates a new task (v2 via intake with owner_work_target).

Restart recovery: claim_existing re-leases attempts with expired lease; drive reuses runtime_run_id (poll) or re-POSTs with same idempotency key (<23h); 404 for accepted run -> uncertain; streams resume with gap flag.
advance_waiters enforces deadlines and expired/revoked grants on all non-terminal tasks.

features.title: Owner questions, approvals/reviews, decisions and attention inbox
features.purpose: Separates information requests (typed questions with answers) from permission for exact actions (approvals), resolves them through authenticated owner endpoints or ordinary chat, closes stale prompts without inventing decisions, and projects everything needing the owner (questions, reviews, results, problems, setup) into a durable versioned attention inbox that drives badges and optional push.

logic.step: hermbot_ask (or legacy review kind=input) -> inputs.ask: validate choices, dedupe by question hash, fence other reviews/ops, insert input_request (expiry min(24h, deadline)), task waiting_input.
Owner answers via card (POST /api/v1/input-requests/{id}/answer) or chat (intake answer_question -> work_items.route answer uses the actual owner text for text questions).

inputs.answer locks task+question, checks hash/type/expiry/stop/conversation/grant/outcome revision, records answer idempotently, appends continuation, requeues unless an attempt is still active; for v2 owner answers creates an auto-intake task and sets resume_after_intake so the original waits for interpretation.

hermbot_review -> request_review: rejects connector-shaped generic reviews, fences pending question/op/review, prepares knowledge/connector payloads, validates secure input, inserts approval with payload hash and expiry, task waiting_approval.
Runtime command approvals come from the Hermes event stream (approval.request) and are inserted idempotently by source_id.

features.title: Conversations: DMs, groups, threads, transcripts, live updates
features.purpose: Owner chats with teammates in one DM per bot or in groups of 2-6 bots. Messages can be threaded (separate native sessions), carry attachments, mentions, skill refs and library files. The UI loads paginated transcripts with reactions, receives live updates through SSE, and can read the authoritative native Hermes history.

Every owner submission inserts a user message with source_id request:{task_id}; bot results insert assistant messages runtime-result:{attempt_id}; both idempotent via ON CONFLICT(source_id).
Threads: reply_to_message_id normalized to the thread root; worker maps thread root+bot to its own native session (thread_sessions) and prefixes the parent message as quoted context.
Mentions must be participants; stored on the owner message.
Attachments must belong to the conversation; worker lists them in the prompt and provisioning copies them into the bot workspace before the run.
Transcript API returns 100 messages per page (before cursor, thread filter) with work association, reply counts, reactions, artifacts, attachments.
Live updates: SSE /api/v1/events polls events every 0.5s; UI EventSource appends message.delta text to partial bubbles and debounces invalidation of state/chat/attention queries.
Archived conversations disappear from /state and block new work, peer messages and attention.
Native history proxied from Hermes /api/sessions/{id}/messages (authoritative incl. compacted).
Reactions toggle, group edit/removal, conversation archive/restore and attachment upload are in product.py.

flows.title: Owner message -> intake -> work item -> dispatch -> native run -> events -> outcome/acceptance -> UI
flows.summary: An owner chat message (intent auto) becomes a queued carrier task; the worker's intake loop interprets it with the bot's model provider and applies work item/requirement changes; claim_new admits the task into an attempt; drive starts a Hermes run; the Hermbot plugin calls /internal/context and /internal/tools during the run; runtime events are streamed into events; settle applies finish claims to outcomes (acceptance) and posts the result message; SSE and /state polling update the UI and attention.

steps.text: UI composer posts POST /api/v1/messages with a client Idempotency-Key and MessageRequest payload (intent defaults to 'auto').
Middleware rejects cross-origin non-GET; owner dependency verifies session cookie/bearer.
submit_message -> submit validates the key and calls service.create_task with orchestration_version=2, coordination_version=1, context chat/group.

create_task: advisory xact lock on request_key, fingerprint compare (replay returns existing row), validations (conversation not archived FOR SHARE, bot active/running, participant, files, skills, thread root, mentions, grants).

INSERT tasks status 'queued'; set budget/attachments; insert owner user message source_id request:{task}; set orchestration_version=2, owner_message_id, intake_status 'pending'; message_intent stays 'auto'; event task.queued. DB trigger attention_tasks marks the task dirty.
Response 202 with task row; UI also receives events via SSE.
Worker process (svc:worker) main loop runs work_intake.run as a background asyncio task.

advance_one claims the oldest queued auto task with intake pending/interpreting per conversation FIFO (FOR UPDATE OF t SKIP LOCKED), sets interpreting + attempts+1 + 60s lease, builds evidence and reads the bot's provider.

interpret() POSTs {provider.base_url}/chat/completions (Bearer decrypted provider key) with INSTRUCTION + evidence, optional read_context tool; validates Interpretation and delivery alignment; up to 4 rounds/45s.
apply() in a new transaction: locked_task, skip if applied/stopped, message hash + observed revision checks, forced target, combined operations, derived tasks for extra operations.
Assignment: work_items.route(intake=True) -> new_item inserts work_items, sets task work_item_id/message_intent 'assignment', links work_item_messages, event work.created.

work_controller.apply registers requirements (work_outcomes, task_outcomes, owner_task_id), bumps revision, records work_authorizations from quoted requested_effects, writes work_changes, emits revise commands to other active tasks, event work.revised.
Intake marks intake_status 'applied' (+intake_result), optional clarification continuation, event message.interpreted.
Worker main loop each second: work_controller.advance (reconcile commands), advance_waiters, claim_existing, then claim_new.

claim_new takes global advisory lock 887832103, schedules inboxes, computes capacity, checks bot eligibility and picks the oldest queued task no longer 'auto'; acquires work item/root/bot locks with SKIP LOCKED; preflight (grant, deadline, budget, connector ops).
Session lookup/creation (sessions or thread_sessions), prompt assembly (input, thread, skills, handoff, attachments, granted files, pending controls), MANAGED_POLICY + COORDINATION_POLICY.
INSERT attempts 'dispatching' (idempotency_key hermbot:{attempt}, 12s lease, worker_id); controls/work_commands 'included'; task 'running'; event task.started (UI clears partial text).
drive(): copy attachments into bot workspace, ensure native session (GET/POST /api/sessions), POST /v1/runs with Idempotency-Key; store runtime_run_id and status running; budget accounting.

Inside the bot, the Hermbot plugin pre_llm_call hook POSTs /internal/context; app.context resolves the admitted task through active_task (attempt by bot+session) and returns message_routing (work, outcomes, owner instructions, authorization), capabilities, connector policy, teammate inbox.
llm_request middleware re-fetches context to cache the work revision, injects inbox, acknowledges inbox and records tool visibility.

Each tool call passes execution_boundary -> admitted_execution: /internal/context with tool_call_id (event tool.admitted), work revision check, routing/capability gating; hermbot_* tools POST /internal/tools with receipt_id=tool_call_id and expected_work_revision.

app.tools validates args (ARGUMENT_MODELS) and requires expected_work_revision; service.tool_action dedupes via tool_receipts, checks revision/waiting_input/routing/require_work, executes the operation (e.g. publish -> artifacts + outcome evidence; finish -> pending_result/pending_outcomes), stores receipt, event tool.receipt.

Concurrently collect_events streams GET /v1/runs/{id}/events; record_event inserts each event (source_id runtime:{attempt}:{seq}, ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING), marks stream complete on run.* terminal events, creates runtime approvals.
drive polls GET /v1/runs/{id}; while running it delivers decisions/controls and queues monitor assessments; on terminal status calls settle and cancels the stream task.
settle(): lock task+attempt, account time, set attempt status/terminal, reconcile_requests, compute task state (completed / waiting_* / failed / recovery requeue).

outcomes.settle re-validates finish claims in a savepoint and records each: accountable owner path -> result_acceptance.record inserts result_acceptances, accepts reviewed contributions, marks outcome fulfilled, event result.accepted.
Completed with output: grant child artifacts to parent, insert assistant message runtime-result:{attempt}, event task.completed (or task.failed when empty / task.{state}).
SSE: GET /api/v1/events polls events id>cursor every 0.5s and yields 'update' frames; UI EventSource appends message.delta and debounces invalidation of state/chat/attention queries.
UI re-fetches /api/v1/state (work_items via list_items + outcomes.projection) and the conversation transcript; WorkItems renders card status/progress.
Notification worker drains attention_pending and materializes a work 'result' item once work is completed and fully settled (or a problem item); Attention panel polls /api/v1/attention.

flows.title: Teammate coordination: message / delegate / wait / finish / read_artifact
flows.summary: A running teammate (coordination v1) delegates contributions to peers, messages them via a durable inbox, waits explicitly for required results (releasing capacity), is resumed by coordination.advance, inspects contributed artifacts, and accepts the shared deliverable at settlement.

steps.text: Manager calls hermbot_teammates to discover peers and their effective capabilities.
hermbot_delegate -> /internal/tools -> tool_action resolves outcome_keys and calls service.delegate.
delegate validates bot/grant/depth/cycle/handoff budget/outcome ids/dependencies/files/skills.

Child task inserted queued/blocked with handoff brief and inherited work item/versions; outcomes.share binds task_outcomes; result_acceptance.assign inserts a pending contribution (or transfers deliverable); dependencies/artifact_access; root handoffs+1; event task.delegated; parent keeps running (v1).
hermbot_message -> coordination.send inserts teammate_messages pending (scoped recipient, validated reply_to); event teammate.message_sent.

If the recipient is running, its next /internal/context returns teammate_inbox; plugin llm_request injects it and POSTs /internal/inbox-delivered -> coordination.delivered marks delivered to that attempt.
If idle, claim_new's schedule_inboxes creates a peer_message discussion task for the recipient and links response_task_id; it then runs like any task and replies with hermbot_message reply_to.

Child runs (flow:a steps for dispatch), publishes artifacts and calls hermbot_finish with results; at settlement result_acceptance.record marks its contribution 'submitted' with submission payload (not fulfilment).
Manager calls hermbot_wait with task_ids/message_ids: coordination_waits inserted (cycle checks), task -> waiting_results; it ends its turn.
Manager's settle keeps it waiting_results (capacity released) while required contributions are unaccepted.
advance_waiters -> coordination.advance: when waits resolve or fail and the update signature changed, requeue the manager with a data-only continuation listing submissions/replies/failures.
Resumed manager inspects contributed files with hermbot_read_artifact (receipt recorded) and work_status.

Manager finishes with results(key, artifact_id, review, reviewed_task_ids); at its settlement validate() checks contributions submitted+completed, reviews listed, read_artifact receipts, review text; result_acceptances inserted, contributions accepted, outcome fulfilled.
Failed required contribution: advance wakes the manager; it may delegate with replaces_task_id (supersede, keep required) or reassign (manager grant).
Legacy v0: delegate sets parent waiting_children; advance_waiters releases blocked dependents and resumes the parent with all child results when children settle.

flows.title: Stop / retry / recovery after worker or container restart
flows.summary: Owner Stop cancels a task tree and the worker stops the native run; Redirect becomes a revision or control; Retry creates a new task after the old tree settles; Continue adds budget. After a worker crash another (or restarted) worker takes over expired attempt leases and reconnects to the same native run identity; ambiguous cases become uncertain instead of replaying.

steps.text: Stop: UI POST /api/v1/tasks/{id}/stop -> service.cancel on the locked task.

cancel walks descendants (or occurrence tree); for each non-terminal task: attempts -> stopping, task -> cancelling (active attempt) / cancelled / stays uncertain; stop_kind/stop_reason; discards monitor controls; cancels pending approvals, questions, lifecycle/knowledge proposals, connector drafts; event task.stop_requested.
drive sees attempt 'stopping' and POSTs /v1/runs/{id}/stop; polling continues until terminal.
settle forces status 'cancelled' for cancelling tasks and uses the stored stop_reason as error; failed parents cancel descendants.
Redirect: POST /api/v1/tasks/{id}/steer (owner_receipts idempotency) -> service.steer: v2 creates an auto-intake task with owner_work_target (revision path, flow:a), legacy inserts a controls row.

deliver_decisions sends one pending control via POST /v1/runs/{id}/steer (dispatching -> delivered); 409 returns it to pending for the next continuation; transport errors mark it uncertain; stale 'dispatching' from an old lease become uncertain.

Retry: POST /api/v1/tasks/{id}/retry requires failed/interrupted/cancelled, not all required results fulfilled, no unknown connector outcomes, no active attempts in tree; creates replacement task (v2 via intake targeting the work item).

Continue after budget pause: POST /api/v1/tasks/{id}/continue -> execution_policy.continue_work adds allowance and restores each paused task to queued/waiting_input/waiting_approval/blocked/waiting_results/waiting_children.
Retry interpretation: POST /api/v1/messages/{id}/retry-interpretation resets intake to pending.

Worker restart: new WORKER_ID; claim_existing re-leases attempts in dispatching/running/waiting_for_approval/stopping/external/reserved whose lease expired (12s) using FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; uncertain attempts are excluded.

drive on a re-leased attempt: with runtime_run_id it skips start and polls the same run; without it, re-POSTs /v1/runs with the same Idempotency-Key (Hermes dedupes), unless the attempt is >23h old (mark_uncertain).
Event stream restarts; coverage flag event_stream_gap records that events may have been missed (prevents later automatic recovery).

Bot container restart: GET /v1/runs/{id} 404 for an accepted run -> attempt/task uncertain (no replay); other HTTP errors keep the receipt and retry next loop; runtime 'interrupted' status settles task interrupted (retryable by owner).

Automatic recovery: settle requeues a definitely failed retryable run (rate limit/provider/connection) when no tool started, coverage complete, grant/connector checks pass, budget left and recovery_failures < MAX_RECOVERIES (default 2); event execution.recovery_queued.
Uncertain tasks/attempts block: bot slot (unique index and claim checks), reassignment/replacement, lifecycle changes and revisions; no code transitions an attempt out of 'uncertain'.
Deadline/grant enforcement each loop: advance_waiters cancels tasks past deadline or with expired/revoked grants.

discrepancies.text: No code path transitions an attempt (or task) out of 'uncertain': error messages and README tell the owner to 'reconcile' uncertain execution, but there is no endpoint for attempt-level reconciliation; retry/reassign/lifecycle/revisions refuse uncertain work, and the partial unique index plus claim_new keep the bot blocked and consume a global max_active slot indefinitely.
app.internal() dependency (INTERNAL_TOKEN) is defined but never used; INTERNAL_TOKEN is only length-checked at startup. /internal/* routes use per-bot tokens instead.
plugin.yaml provides_tools omits hermbot_ask, hermbot_work_status and hermbot_publish_file although the plugin registers them and runtime.capabilities requires every ARGUMENT_MODELS operation.
Attempt status 'waiting_for_approval' is listed in ACTIVE_ATTEMPTS and the unique index but is never written by any code (only compared against runtime status).
Runtime approval cancel: decide() rewrites decision 'cancel' to 'deny'; an idempotent repeat of the same 'cancel' request then hits 'different decision' 409.

Terminal set mismatch: service.TERMINAL includes 'uncertain' but SQL in migration 017 (grant trigger and bootstrap) and attention.reconcile treat only completed/failed/cancelled/interrupted as terminal (intentional for attention, but inconsistent definitions).
/health reports phase 4 and FastAPI version 0.4.0 while README states Phase 5 milestones 5.1-5.3 complete and plugin is 0.5.0.
execution_monitor.COOLDOWN_SECONDS (120) is unused; the cooldown is hard-coded in SQL intervals.
outcome_evidence is write-only: no reader in the codebase (UI shows evidence_strength and acceptance evidence instead).
Steer route without Idempotency-Key uses a random key, so client retries are not idempotent (a v2 Redirect creates a fresh intake task per retry).

README says one active/uncertain attempt per bot and 'Retry ... uncertain execution blocks replay' — consistent; but README describes Redirect as a direction to the same task whereas for v2 work it becomes a new auto-interpreted owner message (work revision) delivered via commands.
Intake FIFO only considers pending/interpreting rows, so a failed earlier interpretation does not hold later messages; after a retry the earlier message is applied after later ones.
CONNECTED-WORK-COORDINATION.md is planned/not started; shared admission across overlapping triggers is not implemented (independent per-trigger admission).

PHASE5-ATTENTION plan specifies a 15-second result coalescing window and 30-second anti-flap for failures; attention.py materializes immediately (any window must live in notifications.enqueue, outside this scope).

durability.text: Owner submissions are idempotent on tasks.request_key (UNIQUE) with an advisory transaction lock on the key and a request_hash fingerprint (409 on mismatch).
Owner mutations use owner_receipts via registry.mutation (Idempotency-Key + request digest).
Bot tool calls are idempotent on tool_receipts id bot:task:tool_call_id with request hash.

Messages and events use source_id UNIQUE + ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING (request:{task}, runtime-result:{attempt}, runtime:{attempt}:{seq}, tool-admission, teammate-delivery); runtime approvals ON CONFLICT(source_id).
Native dispatch idempotency: attempts.idempotency_key 'hermbot:{attempt_id}' sent as Idempotency-Key to Hermes POST /v1/runs, reused on retry within 23h.
Outbox patterns: work_commands + controls written with revisions; attention_pending via DB triggers in the same transaction; acceptances UNIQUE per outcome revision.
Every request runs in one DB transaction (db.connection wraps conn.transaction()); outcome claim settlement uses a nested savepoint.

concurrency.text: Canonical lock order: work item -> root task -> task (service.locked_task), used by API and worker; revoke_grant follows the same order.
Dispatcher admission is serialized by pg_advisory_xact_lock(887832103) and candidate locks use FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED (routine def, work item, root, bot) to avoid waiting while holding a root.
Intake claim, monitor claim, attempt lease takeover and work_controller.reconcile use SKIP LOCKED; route() uses NOWAIT sub-transactions for secondary locks.
Attention drain uses pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(887832154); detail API refuses with 409 if a projector holds it.
Optimistic concurrency via expected revisions/hashes: work_items.revision (expected_work_revision), outcome revision, question_hash, payload_hash, input hash.

workers.text: Worker process: 1s main loop (provisioning, probe/20, work_controller.advance, advance_waiters, knowledge.drive_proposals, connections.drive_one, claim_existing, claim_new, drive gather) plus asyncio loops execution_monitor.run, work_intake.run, routines.run and teaching.run (maintenance + candidate generation).
Notification worker runs attention drain/reconcile/maintenance and push delivery every 0.5s.

recovery.text: Attempt leases (12s) let a restarted worker take over the same attempt and reconnect to the same runtime_run_id; uncertain attempts are never re-driven.
Automatic recovery limited to retryable failures before any tool started with complete event coverage, at most MAX_RECOVERIES (2).
Lost receipts (404 for accepted run, >23h, scheduled stop without receipt) become 'uncertain' requiring reconciliation; interrupted runs settle 'interrupted' and are owner-retryable.
Ambiguous steer deliveries (control 'dispatching' from an old lease) become uncertain, never resent.
Intake lease 60s and 3 attempts; failed interpretation preserved for owner retry.

security.text: Authority only from authenticated context: bot identity from token hash and admitted attempt by session; teammate/tool/artifact content labelled data.
Origin check for credentialed non-GET requests; validation errors strip input.

control-vs-data-plane.text: PostgreSQL is the control plane (coordination, receipts, leases, approvals, projections); Hermes owns execution and native session history.

observability.text: events table is the audit/activity log; activity snapshots distinguish contact from progress; assessments recorded per attempt.

scaling-spof.text: Global claim advisory lock and DB-polling SSE (0.5s per client) bound throughput; single PostgreSQL is SPOF; per-bot single active attempt.

tradeoffs.decision: Backend intake model call before execution
tradeoffs.cost: Extra latency/model cost per message; FIFO per conversation
Bot blocked until manual reconciliation (no API for attempts)

Whether multiple worker processes are intended (leases suggest yes; compose runs one worker service).
How an operator is expected to clear an uncertain attempt (manual SQL?) is undocumented.
